metaShifts.description: The critical change preventing Force Staff and similar abilities/items from being used on Leashed targets significantly elevates the power of Leash as a disable. This makes heroes with Leash much more effective at locking down highly mobile targets, as a common counter-play (forced movement) is now removed. This shifts the meta towards valuing reliable, hard-to-escape disables and punishes heroes reliant on forced movement for escape.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Pounce's Leash is now an even more potent lockdown, making him exceptionally good at isolating and eliminating mobile heroes who previously could Force Staff away.
Ensnare becomes a much more reliable setup for her team's burst or for her illusions to deal damage, as targets cannot escape with Force Staff.
Soulbind's Leash effect is now a definitive death sentence for linked targets, as they cannot use Force Staff to break the link or escape.
Rupture with Aghanim's Scepter, which applies a Leash, becomes a far more lethal threat against mobile heroes, ensuring they cannot Force Staff out of the damage radius.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: The item's utility as a counter-initiation or escape tool against Leash effects has been completely removed, significantly reducing its value in specific matchups.
Similar to Force Staff, Hurricane Pike's active ability can no longer be used to escape Leash, diminishing its defensive utility against heroes with Leash.
Highly reliant on mobility and often builds Force Staff; the inability to use forced movement against Leash makes Puck extremely vulnerable to lockdown.
Blink and Force Staff are critical for her positioning and escape; Leash now completely negates her primary defensive options, making her a prime target.
Shukuchi and Time Lapse provide mobility, but if caught by Leash, his common escape item, Hurricane Pike, is useless, leaving him exposed.

Carry.explanation: Pounce's Leash is now an absolute lockdown, allowing Slark to relentlessly hunt and eliminate high-mobility targets without fear of them escaping with Force Staff or similar items.
Ensnare becomes a much more reliable setup for her team's burst damage and for her illusions to deal sustained damage, as targets cannot escape with forced movement.
Benefits immensely from targets being unable to escape his Overpower and Fury Swipes, allowing him to stick to targets and unleash his full damage potential.
Thrives on reliable lockdown to burst down targets. With Leash preventing escapes, she can more consistently land her critical strikes and secure kills.

Mid.explanation: Rupture with Aghanim's Scepter, which applies a Leash, becomes a far more lethal threat against mobile heroes, ensuring they cannot Force Staff out of the damage radius.
Soulbind's Leash effect is now a definitive death sentence for linked targets, as they cannot use Force Staff to break the link or escape, enabling devastating combos.
Can combo more reliably with Leash effects, as his targets are truly locked down, allowing for easier setup of Sun Strike, Meteor, and other high-impact spells.
Benefits from targets being locked down for his high magical damage output. Leash ensures enemies cannot escape his chain lightning or ultimate, maximizing his impact.

Offlane.explanation: Duel is a powerful lockdown, and with Leash preventing post-Duel escapes, Legion Commander can ensure her targets are fully committed to the fight and cannot flee.
Arena of Blood combined with Leash is a death trap. Targets caught inside cannot escape with Force Staff, making Mars's ultimate even more potent for teamfights.
Charge of Darkness into a Leash effect means no escape for the target, allowing Spirit Breaker and his team to follow up with devastating damage and control.
Doom prevents escapes, and Leash ensures targets cannot Force Staff away from his team's follow-up after the Doom effect ends, making his ultimate even more impactful.

SoftSupport.explanation: Soulbind's Leash effect is now a definitive death sentence for linked targets, as they cannot use Force Staff to break the link or escape, enabling devastating combos.
Fissure and Echo Slam are devastating on immobile targets. Leash effects from allies make his high-impact spells easier to land and maximize their damage and stun duration.
Can steal Leash abilities, turning the enemy's strength against them. Additionally, he benefits from targets being unable to escape his stolen spells or his own Telekinesis.
Magic Missile stun and Wave of Terror armor reduction become more potent when targets are truly locked down by Leash, allowing her team to secure kills more easily.
Sacred Arrow is easier to land and follow up on Leashed targets, turning her into a more reliable stunner and damage dealer in teamfights.

HardSupport.explanation: Ensnare becomes a much more reliable setup for her team's burst damage and for her illusions to deal sustained damage, as targets cannot escape with forced movement.
Frostbite and Freezing Field are devastating on immobile targets. Leash effects from allies make her high-impact spells easier to land and maximize their damage and root duration.
Hex, Earth Spike, and Finger of Death combo is more reliable when targets cannot escape with forced movement, ensuring his burst damage lands.
Maledict and Death Ward are more effective on immobile targets. Leash ensures enemies are stuck in his ultimate's range, maximizing its damage output.
Kinetic Field and Static Storm are more potent when targets cannot escape with Force Staff, making his area control and silence far more impactful.

Carry.explanation: Blink is his primary escape; Leash is a hard counter that completely negates his mobility, making him extremely vulnerable to focused aggression.
Waveform is his primary escape and repositioning tool; Leash makes him extremely vulnerable, as he cannot use it to escape or dodge spells.
Relies on illusions and Doppelganger for evasion and confusion; Leash isolates him, making him an easy target for burst damage.
While Blade Fury and Omnislash provide invulnerability/mobility, if caught by Leash outside these abilities, he's vulnerable and cannot reposition with Force Staff.

Mid.explanation: Heavily reliant on mobility (Phase Shift, Waning Rift) and often builds Force Staff for survival; Leash completely negates his primary defensive options.
Blink and Force Staff are critical for her positioning and escape; Leash now completely negates her primary defensive options, making her a prime target.
Ball Lightning is his primary mobility; if Leashed, he is completely stuck and cannot escape, making him highly susceptible to burst damage.
Sleight of Fist and Fire Remnant provide mobility; if caught by Leash, he is vulnerable and cannot use his remnants to escape, limiting his survivability.

Offlane.explanation: Timber Chain is his primary mobility and escape; Leash makes him a sitting duck, unable to reposition or escape dangerous situations.
Relies on positioning and Vacuum for teamfight control; if caught by Leash, he has no escape and becomes an easy target for the enemy team.
Relies on positioning and Primal Roar for initiation; if caught by Leash, he's vulnerable and cannot reposition to land his spells effectively or escape.
While tanky, if caught by Leash, he can't reposition to land a good Ravage or escape, making him susceptible to being kited or focused down.

SoftSupport.explanation: Leap is her primary escape; Leash makes her very vulnerable, as she cannot use her mobility to reposition or flee from danger.
Rolling Boulder is his primary mobility; if Leashed, he is completely stuck and cannot escape, making him an easy target for enemy heroes.
Relies on Telekinesis for positioning and escape; if he's caught by Leash, he's vulnerable and cannot use Force Staff to reposition.
Scurry and Bushwhack provide mobility and escape; Leash makes her an easy target, as she cannot use her movement abilities to disengage.

HardSupport.explanation: False Promise can save, but if he's caught by Leash, he's vulnerable and cannot reposition, making him an easy target for follow-up damage.
Blinding Light provides pushback, but if he's caught by Leash, he's vulnerable and cannot reposition, making him easy to dive and kill.
Relies on positioning and creeps for impact; if caught by Leash, he's vulnerable and cannot escape, making him a high-priority target.
Shallow Grave saves, but if he's caught by Leash, he's vulnerable and cannot reposition, making him an easy target for focused damage after his save is used.
